thread:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: Canary failures detected for runtime-service in us-west-2 — 5xx rate spike across canary nodes. Paging @eng-infra @oncall

oncall-bot: Links: https://pager.example/INC-2098765432 — runbook: /runbooks/runtime-service-canary-failure.md

alex.k: taking it, joining call now. quick check — is this limited to canary?

sam.r: yep looks canary-only so far. I saw a CI push earlier that retagged an image after a cache hit. tagging job 8234 maybe the culprit.

ci-bot: CI job #8234: push to registry/redwood/runtime:canary-20260310 succeeded (digest: sha256:aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55ff66aa77bb88cc99dd00ee11ff22aa33bb44cc55dd66)

alex.k: checked pods, containers are failing with a native error in the new parser lib, stacktrace mentions invalid ELF header. weird for a userspace change. grabbing pulled image from node to inspect.

alex.k: pulled image from node -> saved as /tmp/runtime-canary-img.tar. running sha256sum on binary inside: 
```
$ sha256sum /opt/runtime/bin/engine
sha256: 7f3a1c2d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b  /opt/runtime/bin/engine
```

alex.k: downloaded artifact from CI storage (s3) for same job and checked sha256: 
```
$ sha256sum engine-8234
sha256: 2b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b7f3a1c2d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f  engine-8234
```

alex.k: checksums differ. suggests non-reproducible build or cache poisoning in build layer.

sam.r: hmm earlier pipeline had a layer cache rehydrate step that injects /build/timestamp into build. we tried to avoid that, but looks like cache made the binary different between CI artifact and what got pushed to registry node.

june.p: customer-facing impact? which customers hit the canary nodes?

jess.prod-observability: initial telemetry: ~18% 5xx on canary slices for requests that exercise parser_v2. No broad outage yet. A/B routing shows ~2% of overall traffic went to affected canaries in us-west-2.

alex.k: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout (disable canary promotion), 2) flip feature flag parser_v2 -> off, 3) rollback canary pods to previous image tag, 4) validate artifact digests before resume.

sam.r: agreed. I'll flip feature flag in config-service: `/flags/parser_v2 = false` — doing it now.

sam.r: done. flag change propagated to gateway in ~12s. observability: parser_v2 traffic dropped to 0.

alex.k: pausing deployment: `kubectl rollout pause deploy/runtime-service -n prod` — done.

devops: rolling back canary to last known-good image: `kubectl set image deploy/runtime-service runtime-service=registry/redwood/runtime:20260303-rc4-canary -n prod` then `kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime-service -n prod --watch`

devops: rollout progressing — canary pod 1 -> Ready, pod 2 -> Ready, healthchecks passing.

jess.prod-observability: 5xx on canaries dropped from 18% -> 0.8% over last 3 minutes. overall error budget unaffected.

ci-bot: note: job #8234 did not produce signed artifacts. rebuilds are currently non-deterministic due to embedded build metadata.

alex.k: postmortem action items so far: (short)
- ensure pipeline pins build inputs and strips timestamps to get reproducible binaries
- add a pre-deploy digest verification step: compare deployed image digest with CI artifact digest before allowing rollout
- enable docker content trust or artifact signing for release images
- add canary gating rule: if canary 5xx > 5% within first 5m, auto-pause rollout and alert
- add regression test for parser binary sanity (ELF header check) in CI

sam.r: I'll open infra PR to add deterministic build flags + content signing. assigning to @sam.r and @devops for rollout guard.

june.p: customer impact summary for ops: "No widespread customer impact. Transient errors limited to canary slices (~2% of traffic) for ~7 minutes before rollback. No data loss. Some API calls returned 5xx for certain tenants routed to the canaries."

alex.k: marking incident as mitigated. keeping thread open for follow-ups on CI fix and gating rules.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT 2098765432 -> MITIGATED by alex.k, sam.r at 2098765492. Create postmortem in /incidents/2098765432-pm.md and link when ready.

sam.r: creating the postmortem now, will include logs, digests, and PR references.

devops: quick notes for runbook update: add `docker inspect --format='{{.Id}}' IMAGE` step and `skopeo inspect` on registry side, verify digests match S3 artifact before `kubectl set image`.

jess.prod-observability: leaving retention alerts to follow — will flag the metric alert until we close the PM.

alex.k: thanks everyone. nice triage. :thumbsup:
